newsitem.title: AUSTRALIA: RTRS-Kishu seen as Tourism Asset seller.
newsitem.headline: RTRS-Kishu seen as Tourism Asset seller.

text.p: Kishu Railway Co Australia Pty Ltd had sold 10.05 million shares in hotel holding company Tourism Asset Holdings Ltd, a corporate source told Reuters on Friday.
The sale of the 8.16 percent stake raised A$10.55 million. The shares were sold for A$1.05 each in morning trade, the source said.

The bulk of the trade was specialled through Burdett, Buckeridge and Young. Tourism Asset is 49 percent controlled by AAPC Ltd, the regional operator of the French-based Accor hotel group. -- Sydney Newsroom 61-2 9373-1800
